svg.title: Six blue tile faces using circle and plus connectors
svg.text: Blue input: four ADJACENT corner squares
L = Life-cell width = blue-tile width. Each lower Life cell still repeats ONE value at its four corners.
1. Four Life cells meeting at a corner
One corner square from each Life cell.
Four touching squares, each L/3 × L/3.
Four data groups + nine fixed raised Xs.
Each 2×2 group repeats the input. Total: L × L.
Six types up to rotation — bottom input → top output
